title: The Lantern Moth
statement: Long ago, when the sky was only dark and nobody had yet thought to look up, a small moth mistook the first star for a lamp left on for her and flew toward it for a thousand years. She never arrived, but the dust from her wings settled into six more lights behind her, so that every wanderer who followed would have a path to follow and a reason to be curious. On clear nights she still trembles, wings opening and closing, and a visitor who watches long enough may see her turn toward them.
